visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a navy blue jacket with white sleeves and blue jeans, stands outdoors against a background of industrial steel beams and autumn-colored trees. He holds a pink 100 NTD bill between his fingers and points toward the lens with a confident expression. (2) The scene changes to the man sitting on a gray concrete ledge in front of a wall covered in large, colorful, stylized graffiti. He carefully peels back the lid of a plastic pudding cup, looking at the residue with an exaggerated facial expression of intense struggle and restraint. (3) A close-up shot captures the silver underside of the pudding lid, followed by a return to the man on the ledge who is now pretending to scream in agony while another hand enters the frame and pulls the lid away from him. (4) The man is shown holding a smartphone, looking at a delivery application interface with various menu items and costs displayed. He points at the screen while laughing and gesturing toward the camera, emphasizing a specific numerical total shown in the app. (5) In a different outdoor setting on a paved walkway, the man walks toward the camera, then receives a green plastic bag containing a cup of green tea from an individual off-screen. He takes a sip through a straw and walks away while a montage of previous scenes plays in grayscale.
